subject: English
question_text: Read the following text and fill in each gap with a
stimulus: suitable word based on the information of the text.15 = 5 21 February is a memorable day in our national history. We observe the day every year as International Mother Language Day. The day is a national holiday. On this day, we pay tribute to the martyrs who laid down their lives to establish Bangla as a state language in undivided Pakistan in 1952. It is known as the Language Movement. The seed of the Language Movement was sown on 21 March 1948 when Mohammad Ali Zinnah, the then Governor General of Pakistan, at a public meeting in Dhaka declared that Urdu would be the only state language of Pakistan. The declaration raised a storm of protest in the eastern part of the country. The protest continued non-stop, gathering momentum day by day. It turned into a movement and reached its climax in 1952. The government outlawed all | 259 sorts of public meetings and rallies to stop it. The students of Dhaka University defied the law and they brought out a peaceful protest procession on 21 February 1952. When the procession reached near Dhaka Medical College, the police opened fire on the students, killing Salam, Rafiq, Barkat, Safiur and Jabbar. As a result, there were mass protests all over the country and the government had to declare Bengali too as a state language. This kindled the sparks of independence movement of Bangladesh. [Unit-3; Lesson-3] 21 Febrary is International Mother Langauage Day. But it (a) ⎯ the most for the Bangalees. The Bengalese (b) ⎯ down their lives for the mother tongue. Thus they (c) ⎯ Bangla as one of the state languages of pakistan. The sacrifice led the Banglees to the (d) ⎯. In other words, language movement worked as the (e) ⎯ of freedom. Read the passage and answer the questions 4 and 5. This is the story of two friends - Lutfur and Asif. They lived in a certain village. Lutfur was the son of a poor cobbler. He mended shoes and earned same money with his father. On the other hand, Asif was the son of a rich man named Azad Chowdhury, who was highly obeyed by the people of the village. He loved his son Asif more than anything o earth. But he did like Lutfur as he had no education and beside he was the son of a cobbler. So he did not want his son to play with Lutfur. He even did not allow Lutfur to come to his house. Lutfur was unhappy and sad. One day Asif said to Lutfur, '' Let's go to the nearby hill. Everybody says that it is beautiful'' so the two friends started from the village. The walked a long distance. They were tired and so, they sat on the bank of a pond. Suddenly they saw something shining in the water. Asif went down to pick it up. But he slipped and he fell into the pond. Asif did not know how to swim. He was about to be drowned. Lutfur jumped into. the water and saved his friend. A neighbour of Azad Chowdhury named Jamal observed the incident. He informed Asif's father of the incident. Azad Chowdhury rushed to the spot and brought the two boys home. He understood his mistake and was ashamed of his previous behaviour. He did not hate Lutfur anymore. He said ''We should love everyone as we are equal''
